In the mathematical discipline known as [[functional analysis]], a '''Triebel–Lizorkin space''' is a generalization of many standard function spaces such as [[Lp space|''L''<sup>''p''</sup> spaces]] and [[Sobolev space]]s.  It is named after {{ill|Hans Triebel|de||pt}} (born February 7th 1936 in [[Dessau]])  and {{ill|Petr Ivanovich Lizorkin|ru|Лизоркин, Пётр Иванович}}.
